versionImpact.rationale: Paper publication now validates protected release authority before expensive build work and treats only enumerated Buildchain-owned ephemeral evidence as outside source version state.

surfaceImpacts.rationale: Exact Buildchain-owned contract-drift and publication-result paths no longer poison strict version verification, while undeclared paths remain rejected and unreadable promotion authority fails before the publication build.

summary: Buildchain v2.11 closes paper publication friction from workflow-generated ephemeral evidence and validates protected release authority before expensive build work.
